items.name: Hand-painted wallpaper installation
items.title: Hand-Painted Wallpaper Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Installation of hand-painted, scenic and chinoiserie wallpapers in London, in the manner of de Gournay and Fromental. Survey, set-out, hang and aftercare.
items.heading: Hand-painted wallpaper installation
items.lede: Scenic, chinoiserie and panelled hand-painted papers, in the manner of de Gournay and Fromental, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: Hand-painted papers need a sound wall, a patient set-out and time. Panels are usually supplied in a sequence, and the scene has to meet across doors, windows and corners. We plan the set-out from a fixed point before the first panel goes up.
Preparation follows the maker's specification. Some papers are hung over a lining, some are not. If the wall is not ready for the material, we say so at the survey.

We install these papers; we do not make them and are not affiliated with any maker. Brown's Hotel, Mayfair includes scenic and chinoiserie wallcoverings, among them Lewis & Wood's Adam's Eden, identified from the selvedge photographed on site.

faq.question: Do hand-painted wallpapers need lining paper?
paragraphs: It depends on the maker's specification. Some are hung over a lining, some are specified without one. We follow the specification.

faq.question: How are scenic wallpaper panels set out?
paragraphs: From a fixed point, in the supplied sequence, so the scene meets where it should around doors, windows and corners. The set-out is agreed before the first panel is hung.

items.name: Grasscloth installation
items.title: Grasscloth Wallpaper Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Grasscloth and natural weave wallcovering installation in London. Seams, colour variation and weave direction agreed before the first length is cut.
items.heading: Grasscloth and natural weave installation
items.lede: Grasscloth, sisal, raffia and other natural weaves, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: The irregularity is the point of the material. Colour and weave vary from roll to roll, and the seams are visible. We agree that, and the direction of the weave, before the first length is cut.
Natural weaves mark easily and do not forgive adhesive on the face. They are hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the backing, following the maker's instruction.
Quantities allow for the variation between rolls, so lengths from the same batch can be kept together on a wall.

faq.question: Will grasscloth seams be visible?
paragraphs: Yes. Visible seams and colour variation between rolls are part of the material. We agree how that will look, and the direction of the weave, before hanging.

faq.question: How do you clean grasscloth?
paragraphs: Gently, and dry. The care notes for each material are on the aftercare page.

items.name: Silk wallcovering installation
items.title: Silk Wallcovering Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Silk wallcovering installation in London houses and hotels. Clean hands, the right adhesive and seams planned so the light does not catch a ridge.
items.heading: Silk wallcovering installation
items.lede: Silk wallcoverings, plain and patterned, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: Silk is lustrous, and quick to mark. It is hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the cloth. Seams are planned so the light from the windows does not catch a ridge.
The wall has to be right first. Preparation, including a lining where the maker specifies one, is written into the scope.
Protection of floors, furniture and finished joinery is part of the hang, not an optional extra.

faq.question: Is silk wallpaper hard to install?
paragraphs: It is unforgiving. Adhesive on the face or a ridge at the seam shows in raking light. That is why the set-out, the adhesive and the preparation are planned before the first length.

items.name: Fabric walling
items.title: Fabric Walling & Textile Wallcovering London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Fabric walling and textile wallcovering installation in London. Wider goods, careful edges at joinery, skirtings and reveals.
items.heading: Fabric walling and textile wallcoverings
items.lede: Textile on the wall, often in wider goods, for drawing rooms, bedrooms, dressing rooms and hotel suites.
paragraphs: Fabric walling needs care at the edges and wherever it meets joinery, skirtings and reveals. The set-out is planned so joins fall where they are least seen.
Paper-backed textiles are hung like a wallcovering. Other fabrics have their own method, and we follow the maker's instruction and the designer's specification.
As with every material, aftercare is included: a return visit once the room has settled, and a twelve-month guarantee on the workmanship.

faq.question: Can you hang wide-width fabric wallcoverings?
paragraphs: Yes. Wider goods need more hands and careful handling, especially at corners and openings. We plan for that in the scope.

items.name: Hotel wallcovering installation
items.title: Hotel Wallcovering Contractor London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Hotel wallcovering contractor in London: contract vinyl, Vescom and specialist papers for bedrooms and corridors. The OWO, Brown's Hotel, Four Seasons.
items.heading: Hotel wallcovering installation
items.lede: Bedrooms, corridors and public areas in London hotels, hung to programme and around the house. Public commissions include The OWO, Brown's Hotel, Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square and hotels in Holborn and at Silverstone.
paragraphs: Contract vinyls are the usual specification in busy hotel rooms and corridors. At The OWO, Whitehall, the install was Vescom wallcoverings, to walls and to parts of the joinery, between 2020 and 2023.

Hotel work moves floor by floor or room by room around guests. Delivery of free-issue goods is timed to the hang, and paper is not left in corridors. A project leader is on site every day, and on a longer commission senior oversight agrees a forward plan each week.

Where Mr Wallcover is appointed as main decorating contractor, the package can include fine painting, French polishing and other specialist finishes, as it did at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, from 2022 to 2024.

faq.question: Can you install wallcoverings in a hotel that stays open?
paragraphs: Yes. Most of our hotel work has been in live buildings. The work is contained, moves around the house's bookings, and the area is left tidy.

faq.question: Do you take the whole decorating package?
paragraphs: We can. At Brown's Hotel and at Hyde London City, the Old Bailey Hotel, Mr Wallcover was the main decorating contractor. Elsewhere we have carried the wallcovering package alone.

items.name: Mural installation
items.title: Wallpaper Mural Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Printed and hand-made wallpaper mural installation in London. Set out from a fixed point so the scene meets around doors and corners.
items.heading: Mural installation
items.lede: Printed and hand-made murals for houses, hotels and shops in London.
paragraphs: Murals are set out from a fixed point so the scene meets where it should, including around doors and corners. Panels are checked against the supplier's layout before hanging.
Some murals are specified with a lining paper and some without. We follow the specification, and we say at the survey if the wall needs work first.
Measurements for a bespoke print are taken on site so the artwork is sized to the wall that will actually be hung.

faq.question: Will you measure the wall for a bespoke mural?
paragraphs: Yes. We measure on site, take out the openings and give the supplier the dimensions of the wall that will actually be hung.

items.name: Acoustic wallcovering installation
items.title: Acoustic Wallcoverings & Panels, London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Acoustic wallcovering and acoustic panel installation in London hotels, offices and homes. Hung to the maker's instruction so the face keeps its performance.
items.heading: Acoustic wallcovering installation
items.lede: Acoustic wallcoverings and panels for hotels, offices, restaurants and homes.
paragraphs: Acoustic wallcoverings and panels are hung so the face keeps the performance it was specified for. Adhesive, trimming and edges follow the maker's instruction.
They often sit alongside other finishes in the same room, so set-out and junctions with joinery and other wallcoverings are planned at the survey.
Aftercare and the twelve-month workmanship guarantee apply as with any other material.

faq.question: Where are acoustic wallcoverings used?
paragraphs: Commonly in hotel corridors and function rooms, restaurants, offices, and in homes where a room needs to be quieter. We install to the maker's specification.

items.name: Architectural & furniture film wrapping
items.title: Architectural & Furniture Wrapping, London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Architectural and furniture film wrapping in London: doors, joinery, lift interiors, reception desks and furniture refinished in place. Survey to aftercare.
items.heading: Architectural & furniture film wrapping
items.lede: Self-adhesive architectural films that refinish doors, joinery, lifts, counters and furniture in place, without stripping out or replacing them.
paragraphs: Architectural film is a thin, self-adhesive surface in wood, stone, metal, leather-look, textured or solid finishes. Applied properly, it renews a door, a run of joinery or a piece of furniture where it stands. There is no spraying on site and no long drying time, and far less goes in the skip than with a replacement.

It suits hotels and offices that cannot close a floor for long: bedroom doors and wardrobes, lift cars and lift lobbies, reception desks, bar fronts, kitchen fronts, wall panelling and loose furniture. Rooms can usually go back into use as each area is finished.

The finish depends on the preparation. Surfaces are cleaned, keyed, filled and primed to the film maker's instruction. Edges, corners and returns are where a wrap succeeds or fails, so we plan them at the survey and agree them on a sample before the run starts.

Where the finish calls for new panels or joinery rather than a wrap, see [wallcoverings on joinery and bespoke panels](/services/joinery-wallcoverings-and-panels/): designed, made and installed as one package.

Trained at Solar Screen's headquarters in Luxembourg in window films (Solar Screen) and architectural and furniture wrapping film (Cover Styl'). We install to the maker's own instructions. The same practice surveys, quantifies, supplies the film if you need it, installs and returns for aftercare.

faq.question: What can architectural film be applied to?
paragraphs: Most smooth, sound and non-porous surfaces: painted or laminated doors, joinery, MDF, metal, lift interiors, counters and furniture. The surface is checked at the survey. Where it is flaking, damp or very textured, it needs work first, and we say so.

faq.question: Can film wrapping be done while a hotel or office stays open?
paragraphs: Usually, yes. There is no spraying and little dust or smell, so work can go room by room or floor by floor, and each area can be handed back as it is finished.

faq.question: Can we see the finish before committing?
paragraphs: Yes. We apply a sample on a real door or panel so the finish, the edges and the colour can be approved in the room's own light before the full run is ordered.

items.name: Window film installation
items.title: Window Film Installation London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Window film installation in London: decorative, privacy, solar control and safety films for homes, hotels, offices and shopfronts. Survey to aftercare.
items.heading: Window film: decorative, privacy, solar and safety
items.lede: Films applied to existing glass: frosted and decorative designs, privacy, solar control and safety films for London homes, hotels, offices and shopfronts.
paragraphs: Window film changes how existing glass behaves without replacing it. There are four families. Decorative films give a frosted, etched, gradient or patterned finish, including logos and manifestations. Privacy films screen a view by day, or hide a room completely. Solar control films reduce heat gain and glare. Safety and security films help hold broken glass together.

The right film depends on the glass, the frame, the orientation and what the room needs. Some films are not suitable for every type of double glazing, so we check the glass and the film maker's guidance before we recommend one.

Glass is cleaned to a high standard, the film is cut to the visible pane and squeegeed out, and edges are finished neatly to the frame. Small moisture haze is normal for a short time while the adhesive cures, and we explain what to expect on the day.

Trained at Solar Screen's headquarters in Luxembourg in window films (Solar Screen) and architectural and furniture wrapping film (Cover Styl'). We install to the maker's instructions. At Hyde London City (the Old Bailey Hotel) we fitted Solar Screen film to the glazing as part of the full decorating package. The same practice surveys, supplies the film if you need it, installs and comes back for aftercare.

faq.question: Which type of window film do I need?
paragraphs: Decorative or frosted film for screening and design, privacy film to hide a view, solar control film for heat and glare, and safety or security film to help hold broken glass together. Some films combine more than one job. We recommend one after seeing the glass and the room.

faq.question: Can window film go on double glazing?
paragraphs: Often, but not every film suits every unit. Solar films in particular can raise the temperature of the glass. We check the glazing type and follow the film maker's guidance on what can be applied.

faq.question: Can window film be removed later?
paragraphs: Yes. Film can be taken off and the glass cleaned, which makes it useful for rented premises, changing branding or a room that changes use.

links.label: Cover Styl' architectural and furniture films

items.name: Joinery wallcoverings & bespoke panels
items.title: Wallcoverings on Joinery & Panels, London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Wallcoverings on doors, wardrobes and panelling, film-wrapped panels, and bespoke wall panels and joinery in London. Design to install, as one managed package.
items.heading: Joinery, panels and the finish between them
items.lede: Wallcoverings carried onto doors, wardrobes, panelling and bespoke furniture. Panels wrapped in specialist architectural film. Bespoke wall panels and joinery made to achieve a specific finish, from design through manufacture to install.
items.serviceType: Wallcovering on joinery and bespoke wall panels
paragraphs: The most considered rooms carry the finish beyond the wall: across doors, wardrobe fronts, panelling and bespoke furniture, so that joinery and walls read as one surface. We apply wallcoverings to joinery with the same discipline as the walls around it. Seams, edges and returns are planned at the survey so the joins disappear.

Joinery is a different surface from plaster. Faces are sealed and primed to suit the material, edges are wrapped or finished tight, and the pattern is carried across doors and frames. At [Lee Broom's Shoreditch showroom](/projects/calico-lee-broom-overture/) we ran Calico Wallpaper's Overture straight across a flush door until it vanished into the drape. At [Raffles London at The OWO](/projects/raffles-london-the-owo/) the wallcovering continued from the walls onto parts of the joinery.

Where a panel, door or carcass needs a new surface rather than paper, we wrap it in specialist architectural film such as Cover Styl', in wood, stone, metal, leather-look and solid finishes. Where film is not the right answer, we finish panels in paper, fabric or relief wallcovering instead. See [architectural and furniture film wrapping](/services/architectural-film-wrapping/) for film on existing joinery.

When the finish a designer wants cannot be bought off the shelf, we create bespoke wall panels and joinery to achieve it: panelling, framed and shaped panels, headboards, and door and wardrobe faces, made to the drawing and the finish. Heritage relief belongs to the same family. At the [Castle of Trematon](/projects/trematon-castle/) we hung Lincrusta relief panels to a laser line.

Everything runs as one managed package. We develop the detail with the designer, agree a sample in the room's own light, make the panels and joinery, then fit, finish and wallcover them on site. One team, one programme and one point of responsibility from the drawing to the handover, followed by the same [aftercare](/aftercare/) as every installation.
Trained at Solar Screen's headquarters in Luxembourg in window films (Solar Screen) and architectural and furniture wrapping film (Cover Styl'). We install to the maker's own instructions.

faq.question: Can wallpaper be applied to doors and wardrobes?
paragraphs: Yes, on sound, smooth joinery that has been sealed and primed for it. The pattern is set out across the doors so it reads as one surface when they are closed, and hinge edges, handles and returns are detailed at the survey.

faq.question: Can you create panels to match a specific finish?
paragraphs: Yes. We create bespoke wall panels and joinery to the drawing, then finish them in wallcovering, film or relief. The finish is designed in from the start rather than applied afterwards, and agreed on a sample before the run is made.

faq.question: Film or wallcovering on joinery: which is better?
paragraphs: Film suits hard-wearing, wipe-clean surfaces in busy areas: hotel bedroom doors, wardrobes, lifts and counters. Wallcovering suits pattern, texture and continuity with the walls. Where both could work, we sample both in the room.

faq.question: Who looks after design, manufacture and installation?
paragraphs: We do, as one managed package. The same team develops the detail, makes the panels and joinery, installs and finishes them, and returns for aftercare, so there is one point of responsibility throughout.

items.name: Exterior works
items.title: Exterior Works London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Full exteriors in London: scaffolding supplied and managed, masonry and render painting, and windows. Public projects in Pimlico and Bayswater.
items.heading: Full exteriors, from scaffold to the finished elevation
items.lede: Scaffolding supplied and managed, with masonry and render painting, windows, cornices and railings. The public record is two full exteriors: St George's Square in Pimlico and Inverness Terrace in Bayswater.
paragraphs: A full exterior is surveyed, scaffolded and painted as one piece of work. The practice supplies and manages the scaffold, then repairs and paints masonry, render and stucco, including cornices, pediments, capitals and parapets. Windows, sills and architraves are finished with the elevation, and so are balconies, balustrades and railings.

At [St George's Square, Pimlico](/projects/pimlico-st-georges-square/) the front and rear scaffolds were supplied and managed here. The work ran from cornice, pediment and portico repairs through masonry and render painting, sills, columns, balustrade and railings. At [Inverness Terrace, Bayswater](/projects/inverness-terrace/) the same approach covered a full scaffolded exterior, front and rear: stucco and render repairs, ornamental capitals and architraves, balconies, the portico, windows and the rear brickwork.

An exterior can be one commission with the interior: all the internal works plus the full exterior, so the decorating and wallpapering inside and the elevation outside are surveyed, programmed and snagged together.

Private residential buildings are published by street only. A survey still decides access, repairs and the programme. After the scaffold is struck, the same [aftercare](/aftercare/) applies as on an interior.

faq.question: Do you supply and manage the scaffold?
paragraphs: Yes. On the exteriors published here, the scaffold was supplied and managed by the practice, including the strike. Access, pavement and the order of elevations are agreed at the survey.

faq.question: What does the masonry and render painting cover?
paragraphs: Stucco, render and masonry, including cornices, mouldings, pediments, parapets and crack repairs before paint. Where the rear is brick, that elevation is in the same scope when the survey includes it.

faq.question: Are windows part of an exterior?
paragraphs: Yes. Sashes, sills and architraves are part of a full exterior, with the entrance joinery, balconies and railings.

faq.question: Can the interior be done with the exterior?
paragraphs: Yes. One commission can be all the internal works plus the full exterior: decorating and wallpapering inside, then the front elevation, with one survey and one programme covering both.
